feeds.title: City Church Blog
feeds.description: LoveHopeCity is a church in Anaheim, California that is passionate about empowering people to know God and grow in their faith. They offer a variety of ministries for people of all ages, including kids, students, adults, and seniors. They also have a strong emphasis on serving the community through outreach and compassion.

feeds.title: The Church in Anaheim
feeds.description: The Church in Anaheim is a Christian church located in Anaheim, California. It is a non-denominational church that welcomes all believers in Jesus Christ. The church's website, https://churchinanaheim.org/, provides information about the church's beliefs, meetings, calendar of events, news, and radio broadcasts.

feeds.title: Christ Reformed Church
feeds.description: The website https://www.christreformed.org/ is the official website of Christ Reformed Church, a Reformed church located in Chino, California. The church offers a variety of ministries, including Sunday worship services, Wednesday Bible study, Friday Night Academy, Adult Sunday School, Archive, Contact Us, Office Hours, and Latest News.

feeds.title: Presbytery of Los Ranchos
feeds.description: With 44 churches spanning an area of more than 2,000 square miles, eight languages spoken in worship, and a region containing 5.3 million people, the Presbytery of Los Ranchos is a diverse tapestry of cultures, churches, and relationships.

feeds.title: Orange County Christian Learning Centers Blog
feeds.description: OCCLC offers an excellent education with Christian values helping parents find safe alternatives to inappropriate and inadequate public school curriculum. In classroom teaching provides for the needs of the children at the most important time in their lives.

feeds.title: Orange County Catholic
feeds.description: OC Catholic is the official news source of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Orange. It is published weekly on Sundays and covers a variety of topics related to the Catholic faith, including local news, events, and faith formation. The website also features a radio station, OC Catholic Radio, which broadcasts Catholic programming 24 hours a day. OC Catholic is a valuable resource for Catholics in Orange County and beyond.

feeds.title: Catholic Charities of Orange County
feeds.description: Since 1976, Catholic Charities has fed the hungry, consoled the hurting, and cared for the marginalized. The church provides help and creates hope for the people of Orange County. The mission of Catholic Charities of Orange County is to provide service to people in need, promote their voice in society, and to call the church and all people to do the same.

feeds.title: Redeemer Church of Orange County
feeds.description: Redeemer Church of Orange County is a non-denominational Christian church located in Newport Beach, California. The church was founded in 2000 and has since grown to over 3,000 members. The church's mission is to 'Love God, Love People, and Make Disciples.' Redeemer Church offers a variety of ministries and programs for all ages, including worship services, Bible studies, small groups, and community outreach.

feeds.title: Pacifica Christian High School Blog
feeds.description: Pacifica Christian High School is a private, college preparatory high school located in Garden Grove, California. Pacifica Christian offers a rigorous academic program that includes a wide range of courses, from AP and honors classes to fine arts and electives. The school also has a strong athletic program, with teams competing in a variety of sports.

feeds.title: Newport Beach Christian Counseling
feeds.description: Newport Beach Christian Counseling is an association of licensed professionals, experienced in helping people of all ages experience healing from a wide variety of struggles. It offers compassionate Christian counseling and psychiatric care that respects your faith and values.

feeds.title: Christian Travel Planners Blog
feeds.description: At LutherTours, the belief is that travel is not just about exploring new destinations; it's about discovering the rich tapestry of faith that connects all believers around the world. With a deep understanding of the Christian heritage and a passion for pilgrimage, the aim is to provide historical, cultural, and transformative travel experiences that nurture the soul and deepen one's spiritual journey.

feeds.title: Friendship Baptist Church Blog
feeds.description: Friendship Baptist Church is a church where CHRIST is magnified. Through individually and collectively presenting ourselves to Christ as a living and Holy offering. They are Bible Based, Christ-Centered, Accountable, and Saved to Serve.

feeds.title: Church of Jesus Christ Temples
feeds.description: ChurchofJesusChristTemples.org shares construction news, photographs, maps, and interesting facts about the temples of the restored Church of Jesus Christ.

feeds.title: Lighthouse Bible OC Blog
feeds.description: Lighthouse Bible Church of Orange County is a Christian church located in Orange, California. The church's mission is to 'make disciples of Jesus Christ by proclaiming the gospel, equipping believers, and serving the community.'

feeds.title: Newport Church Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2006, Newport Church has been loving God and serving the community for more than a decade. Led by Pastors Jonathan and Dianne Wilson, the church is located in the heart of Orange County, California. It is in their hearts to connect you to God, your God-given purpose, and life-giving relationships!

feeds.title: Christian Counseling OC Blog
feeds.description: Kaila Morrison is a licensed Christian therapist in Orange County CA. Helping you meet your needs for faith-based counseling in Orange Country CA. THey are located in Newport Beach, Irvine, Laguna Beach, Mission Viejo, Tustin, Long Beach, and the surrounding areas.

feeds.title: Calvary Chapel of Fullerton Blog
feeds.description: Pastor's Blog is a collection of 'Pastor to Person' articles for Calvary Chapel of Fullerton.

feeds.title: Friends Christian School Blog
feeds.description: Throughout its 45-year history, FCS has provided an outstanding academic experience from preschool through elementary and middle school. Our goal at Friends Christian School is to provide a nurturing, Christ-centered environment with great teachers, outstanding academics, art, music, technology, physical education and competitive athletics

feeds.title: Orange Coast Unitarian Universalist Church Blog
feeds.description: Orange Coast Unitarian Universalist Church is one of more than 1,050 member congregations in the Boston-based Unitarian Universalist Association denomination, a liberal, creedless religion with Judeo-Christian roots.
